LanguageData.RHAH_PlagueSpreading: Ratkin plague is spreading through the colony.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_Plague_Tooltip: Off, new visitors arrive healthy and the plague stops spreading through the colony. People already sick still need treatment.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlaguePerCarrier_Tooltip: Each sick ratkin on the map adds this much chance that a colonist catches it. 0 to 100, default 0.5.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlagueCap_Tooltip: One check gives a colonist at most this chance of catching it. 0 to 100, default 30.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlagueDays_Tooltip: Days between spread checks. 1 to 30, default 3.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlagueHour_Tooltip: The hour of day when spread is checked. 0 to 23, default 6.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlagueBlood_Tooltip: A person at or above this blood pumping stays uninfected. 0 to 300, default 120.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlagueSafe_Tooltip: Off by default. On, the plague stops short of killing. The sick cannot move, but the plague itself leaves them alive.
LanguageData.RHAH_Settings_PlagueSeverity_Tooltip: Highest severity a new infection can reach. 0.01 to 1, default 0.10.
